name: Keli Sensing Technology (Ningbo) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Keli Sensing Technology (Ningbo) Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, manufacture, and sales of various sensors, industrial IoT systems, and multi-scenario application solutions in China and internationally. It offers weighing, photoelectric, water quality, fiber optic temperature measurement, light curtains, gas, displacement, electricity, temperature, humidity, pressure, flow, 3D vision, laser ranging, vibration sensors, and multi-dimensional force sensors for robots. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.
